    Horizon scanning scores (simulated)

    Source: R/data.R
    inv_horizon.Rd

    Simulated scores from four assessors for 30 placeholder candidate taxa (cand_01 to cand_30). Each taxon has a latent score from 1 to 5 for arrival, establishment, spread and impact; each assessor's score is the latent score plus Normal(0, 0.7) noise, rounded and limited to 1 to 5.

    Usage

    inv_horizon

    Format

    A tibble with 120 rows: species, assessor, arrival, establishment, spread, impact and confidence.

    Source

    Simulated in data-raw/make_data.R.

    Examples

    inv_horizon_scan(inv_horizon, arrival:impact, species = species,
  assessor = assessor)
